svg.aria-label: Real-world systems: Face recognition attendance: Marks attendance by recognising faces on camera; PCB mismatch detection: Flags boards that do not match during inspection; TZone temperature gateway system: Own system, no vendor software: decodes raw gateway data into exact records in MongoDB; High-scale MongoDB clustering: Replication and sharding for large, busy datasets; Kubernetes orchestration: Runs streaming and payment platforms in production; Active Directory at Pharma Solutions: Central user accounts and access management
